description: This file contains utility functions for testing, including reading files into memory and printing input/output data for unit tests. It defines functions like read_file_into_memory() which reads the contents of a file into a memory buffer, and print_input_output() which displays the contents of a file and KVP data for debugging purposes.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads a specified file into memory, storing the contents in a provided buffer and setting its length.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (if successfully read) and provided key-value pair data for debugging.
